create_page_intro: Package reusable instructions, scripts and resources into a Skill for Agents to use on demand.
create_blank_caption: Create a workspace and build your Skill through AI chat
create_blank_heading: Build a Skill from scratch with AI chat
create_blank_description: No Skill files yet? Create an empty workspace, then tell the AI what you want to achieve in natural language. It can help generate instructions, scripts and reference materials.
create_blank_step_info_desc: Choose an icon and name. Optionally describe the purpose and use cases to make the Skill easier to find.
create_blank_step_edit_desc: Describe your needs and share examples so the AI can generate and revise Skill files. You can also edit them manually or use the IDE / Terminal.
create_blank_step_test_desc: Test with specific inputs. Once the files and behavior match your expectations, save and publish for Agents to use.
create_blank_form_hint: After creation, tell the AI what you want to achieve in the chat workspace. It will help generate and refine your Skill files. Manual editing and the IDE are also available.
create_import_caption: Reuse existing Skill files and folders
create_import_heading: Bring an existing Skill into your workspace
create_import_description: Use this when you already have a Skill archive. Upload a ZIP file to validate and create a new Skill without overwriting existing Skills.
create_import_step_prepare_desc: Use a ZIP file containing SKILL.md and related scripts or resources. The recommended layout is skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
create_import_step_check_desc: The platform checks folder structure, file formats and sizes. If importing fails, review the reason, correct the archive and retry.
create_import_step_edit_desc: After importing, return to the Skill list. Open the new Skill to inspect its files, continue editing or test it.
create_import_form_hint: Select one ZIP file up to {{maxSize}}. Skills in the archive need a valid SKILL.md; folder structure and content are validated during import.
model_params_invalid: Enter a valid model parameter JSON object (up to 16 KB): temperature 0–2, top_p 0–1, and positive integer token limits. Model, messages, tools and streaming settings cannot be overridden.
skill_resume_unavailable: This continuation was already attempted and cannot safely be replayed. Start a new chat and inspect the retained workspace files.
workspace_terminal_busy: Terminal commands are still running. Stop them before retrying.
workspace_terminal_probe_failed: Terminal activity could not be checked. The operation has not started; please retry.
chat_run_interrupted: Interrupted; inspect the workspace before continuing
editor_return_confirm: Save all IDE files and stop Terminal commands before returning. Unsaved IDE buffers are not included in publication. Confirm that you have done so.
creation_chat_hint: Describe a change or provide a test case. File changes appear in the workspace on the right.
creation_chat_welcome:
### Let's refine this Skill

Describe what you want to build, or continue improving the existing files.

- **Edit the Skill**: describe new rules, workflows, or scripts.
- **Try it out**: provide a concrete input and the expected result.

Expand folders on the right to inspect and edit generated files at any time.
workspace_resize_hint: Drag to resize, double-click to reset, or use the left and right arrow keys
file_recent_changes_hint: Latest changes to up to 8 files since opening this workspace. Select a file to view it.
file_conflict_hint: Agent or Terminal changed this file. Your unsaved edits have been preserved.
file_conflict_error: The workspace file changed. Resolve the conflict first.
file_list_truncated: The file list exceeds the display limit. Use Terminal to inspect remaining files.
file_empty: Empty workspace. Describe your goal in chat; generated files will appear here.
file_select_hint: Select a file to view it. Changes save automatically.
editor_advanced_hint: Advanced IDE / Terminal: save all files and stop running commands before returning to chat.
package_error.invalid_zip: The ZIP is damaged or unsupported. Repack it as a standard ZIP.
package_error.archive_too_large: The ZIP exceeds the upload size limit. Reduce its size and try again.
package_error.too_many_files: The ZIP contains too many files or directories. Remove unnecessary entries.
package_error.file_too_large: A file in the ZIP is too large or cannot be safely decompressed. Reduce its size or repack the ZIP.
package_error.uncompressed_size_exceeded: The total extracted size exceeds the limit. Remove unnecessary content.
package_error.path_too_deep: The ZIP directory structure is too deep. Reduce the nesting depth.
package_error.absolute_path: The ZIP contains an absolute path. Repack it using relative paths.
package_error.path_traversal: The ZIP contains a path traversal (..). Remove unsafe paths and repack it.
package_error.invalid_path: The ZIP contains an invalid path. Remove backslashes, empty path segments or invalid characters.
package_error.duplicate_path: The ZIP contains duplicate paths. Remove duplicate entries and repack it.
package_error.unsupported_file_type: The ZIP contains symbolic links or special files. Only regular files and directories are supported.
package_error.unsupported_compression: The ZIP uses unsupported compression. Repack it using Store or Deflate.
package_error.encrypted_entry: Encrypted ZIP files are not supported. Remove password protection and repack it.
package_error.invalid_utf8: A filename or text file is not valid UTF-8, or text contains NUL characters. Convert the encoding and try again.
package_error.invalid_frontmatter: SKILL.md has invalid YAML frontmatter. Enclose it in --- and provide valid name and description fields.
package_error.missing_skill_md: SKILL.md was not found. Place it at skills/<name>/SKILL.md, the ZIP root or one directory below it. The filename is case-sensitive.
package_error.invalid_layout: The Skill package layout is invalid. Use skills/<name>/SKILL.md without mixed layouts or unrelated root files.
package_error.legacy_layout_not_allowed: This operation requires the skills/<name>/SKILL.md layout. Update the structure and try again.
package_error.duplicate_runtime_name: Multiple SKILL.md files use the same name. Give each Skill a unique name.
package_error.runtime_name_mismatch: The Skill directory name does not match name in SKILL.md. Make them identical.
package_error.invalid_entrypoint: entrypoint.sh must be at the ZIP root and have executable permissions. Fix its path and permissions or remove it.
package_error.checksum_mismatch: ZIP checksum verification failed. The file may be damaged. Download or repack it again.
workspace_detail_failed: Could not load Skill details. Please retry.
workspace_not_ready: The workspace is not ready. Check its current status and error messages.
workspace_unavailable: Workspace unavailable. Refresh its status before retrying.
workspace_stale_publish_confirm: This draft is based on a different published version. Publishing creates a new version from this draft without merging other versions. Continue?
workspace_reset_confirm: This stops every collaborator's editor and replaces the shared workspace with the current published version. Unpublished files and unsaved edits will not be kept in the new workspace. Automatic snapshot recovery is not available. Type the Skill name to confirm.
workspace_replaced: The workspace was reset or access changed. The old editor is closed. Check the status before reopening.
workspace_stale: The published version differs from the draft baseline. Your draft is preserved. Continue editing and publishing, or explicitly reset it.
workspace_preserved: Drafts stay on the persistent volume. Switching published versions does not overwrite them. Publishing includes only files saved to disk.
workspace_recovery_required: The remote operation outcome is unknown. An administrator must verify and recover it. Do not repeatedly create or reset.
workspace_reset_unavailable: Reset is unsafe without a verified persistent volume and no active or unresolved operation.
workspace_read_only: Read access includes published Skills. Editing the workspace requires Write permission.
confirm_delete_tip: Are you sure you want to delete this Skill?
custom_skill_desc: Create a blank Skill template, then edit its content in the workspace
skill_requirement_tooltip_example:
Goal:
Automatically generate meeting minutes from meeting notes.

Process:
1. Identify the meeting topic and participants
2. Extract key discussion points
3. Organize clear conclusions and decisions
4. Extract follow-up action items and note the responsible person (if any)

Requirements:
1. Output in structured format
2. Include: meeting topic, participants, discussion points, decisions, action items
3. Content should be concise and clear, avoiding redundancy
